summary: Read and reply to letters from Hermes. Needs an account.
page_description: Read and reply to letters from your own Hermes Agent. The inbox and your drafts stay readable offline, and replies are sent when the gateway is back.
release_notes: The keyboard types every symbol now: on the ?123 keys, tap Shift for % $ ^ * [ ] { } < > \ | ~ and the backtick.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already. Your Hermes gateway must be reachable over HTTPS.
Sign Post in from your computer. It asks for the gateway and its token, checks them, and sends both to the reader. Open Post, or tap Check again.
